newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bank Melbourne jumps on St George talk.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bank Melbourne jumps on St George talk.

text.p: Shares in Victorian-based regional bank, the Bank of Melbourne Ltd, jumped sharply in early trading on Tuesday after St George Bank Ltd said on Monday it would still consider acquisitions despite having just merged with Advance Bank.
By 10.20 a.m. (2320 GMT), Bank of Melbourne shares were 22 cents higher at A$8.30 on turnover of 135,748 shares.

The Australian Financial Review reported St George Bank chairman Frank Conroy as saying that the Victorian market was a prime target and Bank of Melbourne a very attractive institution to a lot of people.

"The newspaper reports are what is influencing it this morning," said a Sydney broker, adding that activity in the remaining regional banks would probably intensify ahead of the release of the Wallis report into the financial industry, due by the end of March.
"There will likely be more of this talk in the run up to Wallis."
By 12.00 p.m. (0100 GMT), Bank of Melbourne shares were 14 cents higher at A$8.22 on turnover of 292,779 shares.
